goals.title: Orient in the service topology
goals.concept: A service map makes shared dependencies and fan-in relationships visible.

goals.reasoning: Topology narrows the investigation to nodes shared by affected services.
goals.evidence: The map shows the checkout and orders paths.

goals.concept: A node reached by multiple degraded services is a stronger candidate than an isolated downstream call.
goals.narration: Select the node shared by the affected paths.
goals.reasoning: The common node explains correlated degradation across services.
goals.evidence: The selected node is connected to both affected services.

goals.evidence: The selected dependency has corroborating slow trace activity.
